file1.title: Gold 2021-2026, month by month: Monday to Friday, no news window, no time window
setup: Every day the market is open (Monday to Friday; the New York Friday session that runs past midnight IST is included).
No time window, no kill zones, no daily news window: every signal of the strategy is taken (as many trades as possible).
Each strategy keeps its signal settings; its own day / hour / kill-zone filter (9 of the 19 have one) is removed.

file2.title: Gold 2021-2026, month by month: Tue / Wed / Thu, kill zones Asia + London + New York, daily news 17:45-18:15 IST
setup: Trades only on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday (Indian time, IST).
Kill zones Asia 05:30-09:30, London 11:30-14:30 and New York 16:30-19:30 IST (London Close off). They follow summer time: London 1 hour later in UK winter, New York 1 hour later in US winter.

Daily news window 17:45-18:15 IST that follows New York time (18:45-19:15 IST in US winter). No new trades from 60 minutes before it until it ends; at its start an open trade is closed at market and a waiting entry is cancelled (the strategy's own news rules).
Each strategy keeps its signal settings; its own day / hour / kill-zone filter (9 of the 19 have one) is replaced by this setup.

common: Each month is tested on its own, from its first day to its last day (Indian time): only the trades opened in that month, a fresh $10,000 account and a fresh loss-recovery state on the 1st.
Base risk $50 per trade. The gold spread is counted as the cost of every trade. The position size respects the strategy's 1:100 leverage limit; lots are not rounded.
Data: gold M1 bars 4 Jan 2021 to 2 Oct 2026 (October 2026 has only 2 days). Same engine as the TradingView indicator / strategy and the MT5 EA (checked trade for trade).
The 19 strategies are the ones that were profitable at a fixed $50 in the earlier gold study (no partial close). Their names describe what they were picked for, with their own filters.
Research results on past data only; they do not promise future results.
columns: Trades / Wins / Losses / Net R: every trade the setup takes in the month (the skip rules take fewer: see Trades taken).
Net $: the month's profit or loss with each loss-recovery rule (the account starts at $10,000 every month).
Biggest fall $: the largest drop from a high of the account within the month.
Biggest loss $: the largest single losing trade of the month.
Red cell: the $10,000 account was blown that month (never happened in these runs unless shown).
